title: 冬景色 (Fuyu Geshiki — Winter Scenery)
description: A serene Meiji-era school song painting three vignettes of winter: a misty dawn harbor with frost on the boats and only water birds calling; a mild late-autumn midday with crows, wheat-treading farmers, and stray blossoms; and a stormy village evening where only a glimpse of lamplight reveals a house in the dark. Three haiku-like scenes rendered as a Japanese school song.
